object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests, with blind tests written from the requirements alone for what they missed.
object.description: List the commits that changed an object's file or figure since a given commit: (a) on a straight history; (b) where a branch forked before that commit, changed the figure and was merged, in either parent order; (c) where a rebase left that commit off the history. Expected: (a) only the later commits; (b) the branch's commit and the merge; (c) only the rebased commit.
